_comment: Project-level, NOT part of the user-level design-extractor agent/skill. Lives in this repo's root. Lists which screens (by their literal {{stateName}} binding, e.g. from Super_Admin_Flow_dc.html) need near-100% UI fidelity. Everything else defaults to 'standard' — UX/structure correctness matters most, exact pixel values have more tolerance. Edit this list per project; the agent never invents one.
